purpose: Supplementary user questions. Judgments fixed before ranking, independently of the 32-query development corpus. Retrieval relevance does not establish capability completeness.

cases.query: find all places across functions and repositories, where this column gets read and gets written
cases.boundary: impact supports a column target and code_search can recover exact textual evidence. pg_usage supplies table/function context; table-level usage is not column-level read/write proof. Dynamic SQL, reflection and stale/missing indexes require explicit gaps.

cases.query: recreate bug locally - find all related entities in databases,es,kafka messages to recreate state that would recreate bug
cases.boundary: PG/Kafka related fixtures and bounded ES read-state capture are separate stages. Correlation, complete cross-system state and reproduction of the actual bug require evidence and a runnable adapter; a capture alone proves neither.

cases.query: refactor method that takes postgres function results, but fills some fields from other functions, check it still same locally and on dev environment
cases.boundary: Inspect exact function/method identities, preserve representative state and independently compare old/new return values and effects. test_run is local/scratch execution; a dev query or read-only experiment does not deploy the refactor or prove its behavior in the dev service.

cases.query: run this test on dev environment
cases.boundary: test_run env selects source schema/fixture inputs and can arrange scratch databases. It does not run the test against the deployed dev application. Ask which test, runner and target resources are intended; preserve existing push and live mutation boundaries.
